node.title: Re: Order of operations
node.author: Marshall
node.doctext:
The Perl print statement allows an optional file handle right after "print", like print $handle stuff....
You are confusing print.

In your code: print "(4-1) + 2+3 * (2*2) = ", (4-1) + 2+3 * (2*2), "\n\n"; #script 1 answer 17 print (4-1) + 2+3 * (2*2);#script 2 does not work add a dummy null string at the beginning to script 2: print "",(4-1) + 2+3 * (2*2); This makes it clear that the first arg is not a file handle.
